Dimensionality Experiment

Dimensionality experiment for a multivariate SCM with intercept.

The coefficient-prior scaling is either 1k or sqrtk. Sampler settings and the selected model parameterization are written into every result row.

Run python experiment_dimensionality.py --help for the command-line interface.

experiment_dimensionality.main(agent_priors, modified_prior, k, A1_treatment=20, A0_treatment=10, plate_size=1000, draws=1000, parameter_descriptions={'agent_priors': 'Default', 'scm_constants': 'Default', 'scm_noise_parameters': 'Default'}, sampler_settings=None, output_dir='./results/dim_runs', rng=4, observed_x=None, observation_rng=None, data_rng=None, result_metadata=None)[source]

Run one experiment trial with k-dimensional X.

Parameters:

  • agent_priors (dict) – Prior parameter dict (already modified if needed).

  • modified_prior (dict) – {'modified_prior': name, 'modified_prior_value': value}.

  • k (int) – Number of covariates (dimensionality of X).

  • A1_treatment (float) – Value of treatment 1.

  • A0_treatment (float) – Value of treatment 0.

  • plate_size (int) – Number of historical observations for the ML model.

  • draws (int) – posterior draw count per chain, also used for the predictive and CATE sample summaries.

  • parameter_descriptions (dict) – Labels written to the result row.

  • sampler_settings (dict) – draws, tune, chains and target_accept passed to the sampler.

  • output_dir (str or Path) – Directory for the per-run CSV file.

  • rng – Seed or NumPy Generator for the observed patient, sampler, and predictive simulations.

  • observed_x (array-like or None) – Optional observed feature vector. When omitted, it is sampled from the true covariate distribution.

  • observation_rng – Optional independent seed or NumPy Generator used only to generate X_o.

  • data_rng – Optional independent seed or NumPy Generator for the historical dataset.

  • result_metadata (dict or None) – Additional provenance fields written to the result row.
